heavy_finding: Below saturation (2-8k) all three overlap ~2.5-4.6ms within n=4 noise. At the 10k knee (~91% of the DB ceiling) tails diverge: exeris p99 highest (16.5ms), quarkus-tuned lowest (5.1ms), quarkus-hibernate mid (9.9ms). SUSPECT — this campaign was UNPINNED (see status), and the light data proved the shared-cpuset contention hits runtimes UNEQUALLY, so the 10k ordering may be contention-driven rather than inherent tail behavior. NOT a 'same-conditions fair' comparison as originally claimed. Re-confirm with the pinned re-run.
light_achieved_shortfall: quarkus-tuned achieved<<offered at 15k(13736)/20k(17024)/25k(20808); exeris + quarkus-hibernate achieved=offered through 25k.

quarantine.reason: open-loop degeneracy: attain<99% (target could not sustain the fixed offered rate, so CO-corrected percentiles are queue-wait not service time) and/or inf-parsed non-monotonic p99. These leaves are NOT valid latency and were wrongly passed as comparison_eligible.
quarantine.gate_gap: the stage7 gate lacks an attain<99% (open-loop) check and a p99<p50 monotonicity check; the wrk2 parser turns inf percentiles into bogus finite ms. Fix tracked in chip task_da5d9718.

light_finding: quarkus-tuned COLLAPSES above ~14k light (p99 in seconds, achieved<<offered); exeris + quarkus-hibernate scale to 25k (~2ms flat). BUT this campaign was UNPINNED (wrapper error — see status), so the collapse is an artifact of shared-cpuset-0-15 CPU contention hitting quarkus-tuned's native-epoll, NOT an isolated-runtime result (it did ~47k light ISOLATED). Pinning IS achievable (60707c4 did it: both pair-targets to target-cpuset 0-1,8-9, loadgen 2-3,10-11, DB 4-7,12-15) — my wrapper simply omitted it. A pinned re-run is required before any light-latency claim.
caveats: CPU-PINNING ERROR (see status): this campaign was UNPINNED (shared cpuset 0-15), which does NOT match 60707c4 (which was pinned target 0-1,8-9 / loadgen 2-3,10-11 / DB 4-7,12-15).
